description: A line comment can end at the end of the file instead of a newline
notes: A line comment is equivalent to a newline, so it ends the attribute before it. The only open question is whether a line comment may end at the end of the file instead of at a newline sequence, which the spec doesn't say. hashicorp/hcl accepts it: the Comment rule in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl makes the comment's final newline optional, peeker.nextToken in hclsyntax/peeker.go drops a comment that doesn't end with a newline, and parser.finishParsingBodyAttribute in hclsyntax/parser.go accepts the end of the file after an attribute.
